unit.why: A single narrative: the Seer of Lublin perceives a wagon-driver's soul shining, and hasidim find him dancing after he gave all his money so an orphan's wedding could go ahead.

stories.start_quote: פ"א נסעו חסידים גדולים ללובלין עם
stories.summary_en: When hasidim hand the Seer of Lublin a kvitl from their simple wagon-driver, the Seer says the man's soul shines greatly; they search the town and find him dancing in joy because he had just given all his travel money to buy a tallit for the groom, saving an orphan bride's wedding.
